guidance.bestFor: The minimal pattern with no classes on the stack: default size, neutral tones and one small layers glyph
Small, Default and Large stacks side by side with captions, the glyph growing from size-3.5 to size-6
Neutral, primary, success and warning tints in a captioned row, set on the stack and the glyph separately
agentNotes: `text-success` and `text-warning` need success and warning color tokens in your theme; this item installs none, so without them those 2 stacks stay untinted

guidance.bestFor: A round bordered chip with a check mark in place of a bare glyph, on a larger primary stack
A first run workspace screen with the stack above a title, description and Invite team and Connect source buttons
agentNotes: The Invite team and Connect source `Button` elements have no handler; wire them to your invite and data source flows

whenNotToUse.when: A flat glyph in a square bordered surface above the no data message

guidance.bestFor: The smallest stack in the set, 44 by 48 pixels, as media in an outlined row with a title and description

whenNotToUse.when: A list row whose media is a plain glyph, avatar or image
